description: Weblitz, by SSRS2: HTML, CSS and JavaScript to PDF from a .NET library, printed as Chrome prints them: no browser to install or drive. Flexbox, grid, paged media (@page, margin boxes, page breaks), web fonts, SVG, and the page's scripts (React, Chart.js...) run once before printing. .NET 8, 9, 10 and 11 on Windows, Linux and macOS. Licensed with SSRS2's licence key: one key for SSRS2's reports and Weblitz.
releaseNotes: 2.0.0-beta.4: live pages checked beside Chrome (151 public pages): web fonts are fetched by unicode-range as Chrome fetches them, content-visibility: auto and lazy images load where Chrome's do, and the layout and print differences found on those pages are fixed. Pages that animate print faster: styles, layout and SVG icons are kept from one frame to the next where nothing changed for them, and a playing video's frame is decoded once. New options: Consent = Hide (consent boxes are left out, nothing is clicked), Ads = Block (advertisements and trackers are left out by the EasyList filter lists, shipped beside the assembly and updated with HtmlToPdf.UpdateFilterListsAsync), Automated (navigator.webdriver, true by default), UserAgent. 2.0.0-beta.3: a chart or any other canvas drawing prints on a page shrunk to fit its paper (it was left empty where the page's styles use viewport units: Chart.js's own documentation on A4). 2.0.0-beta.2: without a licence, the trial watermark runs across each page, as on reports (2.0.0-beta.1 drew it small in the page's top-left corner). 2.0.0-beta.1: the first beta of Weblitz, SSRS2's HTML engine. Details: https://ssrs2.net
title: Weblitz: HTML to PDF for .NET, by SSRS2
